newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 17.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 17.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:

* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 92.71 points, or 1.41 percent, at 6,679.87 amid reports that tobacco companies are negotiating a settlement of massive lawsuits against the industry.
* Indonesia's PT Multipolar Corporation said retail tycoon Hari Dharmawan has bought a 10-percent stake in Multipolar for 56 billion rupiah.
* Foreign Minister Ali Alatas reassured foreign investors on Wednesday that the nation was politically stable and a good place to do business despite a spate of recent minor disturbances.
* On Wednesday, the Jakarta composite index rose 1.55 points, to close at 632.82 points.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,409.25/09.75 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,407.75/08.75.
* Retailers Multipolar and Matahari after reports that Matahari president director Hari Dharmawan in his personal capacity has bought a 10-percent stake in Multipolar.
* Bank BNI on reports of an estimated increase in its first quarter earnings.
* Bank Umum Servitia on reports its unaudited first quarter results were better than expected and that it posted a sharp increase in its 1996 net profit.
